tldr: Saturn in Gemini: discipline must be learned through thought, language, and communication.
body: With Saturn in Gemini, the work is refining the mind, choosing words carefully, and trusting that your voice can become stronger through practice.
gift: Serious study, precise communication, and the ability to turn scattered ideas into structure.
challenge: Fear of speaking, mental rigidity, or using skepticism to avoid curiosity.
